items.actClause:
AN ACT to amend the election law, in relation to changes to the entrance and
exit of polling places
items.memo:
BILL NUMBER: S5188

SPONSOR: MAYER
 
TITLE OF BILL:  An act to amend the election law, in relation to
changes to the entrance and exit of polling places

 
PURPOSE OR GENERAL IDEA OF BILL:

To ensure that while polling locations are open, the entrance to and
exit from the locations are not altered, except to increase access or to
maintain public safety, and any alteration is clearly marked with
signage next to the former entrance or exit.

 
SUMMARY OF PROVISIONS:

Section 1 of the bill amends Subdivision 1 of section 8-104 of the
election law, as amended by chapter 263 of the laws of 2003, to provide
that while polling locations are open, neither the entrance nor the exit
shall be altered unless the change increases access for persons with
disabilities or in order to maintain public safety or due to an emergen-
cy. Any alteration must be clearly marked with signage placed adjacent
to the former entrance or exit.

Section 2 establishes the effective date.

 
JUSTIFICATION:

Changes in the entrance or exit to a polling location, and lack of
signage concerning those changes, cause confusion and increases barriers
to political participation. This bill reduces barriers to voting by
reducing the likelihood voters will be confused about the polling
location and entrance.

 
PRIOR LEGISLATIVE HISTORY:

New bill

 
FISCAL IMPLICATIONS FOR STATE AND LOCAL GOVERNMENTS:

None

 
EFFECTIVE DATE:
This act shall take effect immediately. The addition, amendment and/or
repeal of any rule or regulation necessary for the implementation of
this act on its effective date are authorized to be made on or before
such date.

summary: Prohibits the making of any change, alteration or modification to any entrance to or exit from a polling place unless such change, alteration or modification is necessary to maintain public safety due to the occurrence of an emergency, and requires the posting of signage in relation to such change, alteration or modification.
title: Relates to changes to the entrance and exit of polling places
